bio: To the southwest of Mendoza, a little out of the way, but definitely worth a visit! After the winding road that leads to this estate-winery (Sitio La Estocada), your reward is discovering a truly extraordinary family project, with renowned winemaker Matías Michelini behind it all. The restaurant, known for its pleasant covered terrace, has a completely open kitchen, which allows us to feel the warmth of the fire at close proximity. Conscious gastronomy is the order of the day, as all products (both vegetable and animal) are self-produced based on organic and biodynamic agriculture that respects natural cycles. Chef Enzo González Petra proposes a unique 7-course tasting menu (with the option of wine pairing) that immerses you directly in the environment (Vegetable Gardens, Sky, Earth, Andean River, Farm...). Make your visit unforgettable by opting for the Exploration experience!
